title: LemGendizedAIHelperLemGend
subtitle: Authoritative Fine-Tuning Corpus for LemGendary AI Studio Assistant (120 Conversational Records)
description:
The LemGendizedAIHelperLemGend corpus is the official, verified fine-tuning and evaluation dataset for AI LemGend, the interactive assistant integrated into LemGendary AI Studio. Comprising 120 supervised instruction-tuning records (80 training pairs, 40 held-out validation pairs), this dataset formalizes procedural knowledge, operational parameters, diagnostic triage protocols, and architectural specifications across the entire LemGendary AI ecosystem.

### Corpus Architecture
Each record contains a multi-turn conversation format with structured system, user, and assistant turns, adhering to the 3-Stage Diagnostic Intake Protocol and epistemic confidence markers ([CONFIRMED], [PROBABLE], [ILLUSTRATIVE]).

### Operational Scope
- GUI Procedures: Step-by-step guidance for LemGendary AI Studio desktop application (Tauri v2 + React).
- CLI Commands: Command-line reference for the lemtrain training engine.
- API Integrations: OpenAPI endpoints, REST methods, and WebSocket streams across Ports 8000, 8100, and 8200.
- Model Selection & SOTA Ladders: Architecture choices across all 22 supported model families.
- Diagnostic Triage: Safe triage, telemetry analysis, and bounded remediation for training failure modes.
